steps.content: After frantically opening your eyes, a white desert comes into focus. You are squeezed and pushed forth by the surging crowd.
Yet... no footprints are left behind you.
In the blink of an eye, the massive sandstorm blanketed the sky with an ear-splitting roar, slamming into you from all sides.
One by one, countless figures are disintegrated into tiny specks of dust across the infinite desert. Only one figure stands firm in the midst of the storm, extending a helping hand towards you.
Echoes from the abyss keep murmuring in your ears...

steps.speaker: Echo in Dream
steps.content: Come, come to where I am...

steps.speaker: Echo in Dream
steps.content: This... is where you truly belong...

You jolt awake from the sandstorm, greeted by the familiar ceiling of your sleeping quarters. Lately you've been dreaming the same eerie scenes over and over again. You've lost track of how many times these dreams have recurred.

The tasks you have at hand are numerous but trivial in nature. There hasn't been any major trouble from the Sinners in the Bureau, and your health report shows that all is well. Thus, there can only be one reason for this abnormal situation...
You look at the surveillance feed from the lab.
A dull, grayish-white crystal sits inside a sealed chamber. The lasers scan it repeatedly, but the values shown by the device remain flat... It is clear that it has long lost its reactivity.
This is the "special crystal" that the FAC sent over for analysis not long ago, the Ash Crystal, which also marks the beginning of your strange dreams.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You're awake. Chief Guillotin of the <color=#fb9259>Outland Affairs Bureau</color> is requesting internal communications access.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: He wants to discuss the "special crystal" with you. He also has a cooperation proposal.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Hello, MBCC Chief. I'm Guillotin, Chief of Outland Affairs Bureau.

The Outland Affairs Bureau, officially the <color=#fb9259>DisCity Outland Affairs Management Bureau</color>, is responsible for coordinating and managing matters pertaining to the city's external relations, such as trade, diplomacy, and immigration.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: I hear that the analysis assigned to your office has not progressed at all. I am very concerned that this will affect our next collaboration... A very important one.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Do you remember the <color=#fb9259>WhiteSands Crisis Cooperation Proposal</color> submitted by the Outland Affairs Bureau? FAC has approved it and sent the application to the 9th Agency with the decision that MBCC would join alongside in battle.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I certainly remember. However, the FAC's instructions were to prioritize the analysis of the Ash Crystal.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Hmph. It is precisely because nothing came of your analysis, and we can only give you a new combat mission!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: As you know, we now hold the only strategic resource that can withstand the Apocalypse—Hypercubes. Thus, we have repeatedly surmounted the barriers of WhiteSands navigation and pilotage.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Thanks to years of endless toil by the Outland Affairs Bureau, DisCity has been able to build a huge trade network in WhiteSands, negotiate with the Outlands by using Hypercubes as leverage, and become the center of the world and the beacon of human renaissance.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: But recently, a horde of bandits appeared in WhiteSands and tried to rob our resources!
Raising his plump chin, the Outland Affairs Chief fishes out a letter with a grunt.
Nightingale opens the mail, revealing a panoramic map of WhiteSands.
The infinite white desert is almost identical to the pure white realm of your dreams.

After the Perishing Star struck, the Nightfall Apocalypse swept across the world. A special white desert emerged from the heart of the desert as a result, gradually radiating and expanding outward. By now, the entire desert surrounding DisCity has transformed into a sea of white sand.

The heart of WhiteSands has long been ravaged by a mega-sandstorm known as the Tide of Ashes, which hinders DisCity from continuing to expand its transport routes and brings about a plethora of deadly secondary disasters.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Three months ago, WhiteSands' sandstorm and secondary disasters suddenly became active. The gun-toting desert bandits seized the opportunity to repeatedly raid our trade routes and rob our Hypercubes.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It was not until a week ago that these anomalies caught the attention of the FAC, who then allocated manpower for an emergency clean-up mission. During the battle, the FAC witnessed a desert bandit wielding an unknown crystal, from which he obtained some kind of mysterious power similar to Sinners. We believe this is why the bandits acted as though they were invincible.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: After comparing residual energy waveforms, the unidentified crystal matched the Ash Crystal that EDGE obtained from the Tide of Ashes many years ago.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes. And that's why they gave us the crystal to analyze.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Yet your analysis has produced nothing so far.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Would you like to give it a try?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In that case, esteemed Outland Affairs Bureau Chief, would you like to try analyzing it yourself?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Under your magnanimous leadership, perhaps it will spring to life and share with you its story.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: You...!
You ignore Guillotin's outburst and continue to read the letter with Nightingale.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This week, the FAC provided even more personnel to support the Outland Affairs Bureau, stretching its manpower capacity to the limit. Thus, it no longer has sufficient manpower to investigate the relationship between the desert bandits and the crystals in WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Therefore, we need the MBCC to discreetly probe the source of the desert bandits' power. If it's indeed related to Sinners, arrest them immediately! This shall be a critical battle!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Those greedy, despicable Outlanders will use all sorts of dirty tricks to rob our Hypercubes! Do you know how many vital trade routes they've sabotaged? How much business, resources and money we've lost?
Guillotin is hysterical with anger on the other end of the comms, grinding his teeth ferociously as he speaks.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Anyway, that's the situation! I'm only giving you these confidential clues because the FAC repeatedly requested for the Outland Affairs Bureau to share intelligence... Here is a record of the desert bandits' actions in the past three months. Use it well.
The desert bandits have been rampant for nearly three months, and still have not been brought under control. They hid their activity so well that even the FAC learned about it only a week ago.

It seems that Chief Guillotin didn't take the desert bandits seriously at first. Only when the official trading posts and sandstorm shelters were sacked, and the Hypercubes sustaining transport were stolen, did he realize the severity of the matter and began to seek help left and right.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Be careful, Chief ${PlayerName}. You are now dabbling with DisCity's lifeline. Under normal circumstances, you wouldn't have this privilege.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Don't try anything funny and don't let us down, MBCC Chief.
Guillotin stops here and hangs up the comms.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, this may not be the most pleasant mission, but the FAC really has no time to wait for the sample's analysis results. They want you to leave right away.

You stare at the panoramic map. The recurring dream and the voice calling out to you surface in your mind once more. This operation... is not just any mission. Perhaps... you can also discover the truth behind the dream.

<color=#fb9259>DisCity's Port 12</color> is not the city's main port, but the trade volume is still impressive. In the early morning, hundreds of sand ships of all shapes and sizes are moored at the maintenance dock. They shall travel through the Apocalypse, delivering cargo and linking the scattered remains of civilization to the new beacon of humanity.
However, even though the shipping containers pile as high as a grand fortress, this magnificent port is humbled by the vast WhiteSands before it.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ptui ptui! After standing here for just two minutes, the amount of sand in my mouth has already outnumbered every grain of rice I ever ate!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey Chief, lend me a hiding spot! My face is going to become weathered like sandpaper in this climate.

Even though you are wearing outfits specially designed for WhiteSands, you still struggle to withstand the power of the sandstorm. The port is still at least a few kilometers away from the sandstorm, yet the ground is already shaking from its mighty roar.
Sand ships must have sufficient weight and technical support, or else they would disintegrate into sand like the boulders by the edge of the storm.
Here and now, the glorious vessels mooring at the port suddenly appear frail and piteous before the storm.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is the huge sandstorm that Nightingale spoke of... the <color=#fb9259>Tide of Ashes</color>.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: They call it a special mission, but no one's here to greet us! Does that old fart from the Outland Affairs Bureau want us to dive into WhiteSands wrapped in cloaks?

According to the mission guidelines, you are to escort the Ash Crystal to Port 12 and wait for the greeting party there. Yet now, one can only imagine what kind of "greeting party" will be strong enough to withstand such a fearsome sandstorm.
The sandstorm from your dreams is surfacing before your eyes. Perhaps instead of the desert bandits, WhiteSands is your greatest enemy, hiding the biggest and darkest secrets.
O guest from a land far, far away... a look of bewilderment lingers on your face. Would you like some help?
An ethereal voice echoes from behind you. You turn around to see a woman donning exotic garb standing behind you... You don't know how long she has been there.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: Yes, you are a guest to WhiteSands. You have your reasons for going there, and answers you wish to seek.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: However, you don't know where to begin. After all, you have found neither a way to enter, nor anyone to guide you.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: Hehe... a guest of WhiteSands is a guest of mine. I can guide you along the path ahead and answer your innermost questions.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I forgot to introduce myself. I am Stargazer of WhiteSands. Would you like a prediction from me? Or perhaps...
She takes out a translucent crystal ball. Your image is reflected inside, with the twinkling starlight seemingly trying to bewitch you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Would you like me to... interpret some dreams you don't understand?
Your prompt refusal does not upset her. On the contrary, a faint smile spreads across her alluring face, half hidden by the brim of her hat.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No worries... No worries at all. Simply regard my offer as a blessing from WhiteSands.
Though you weren't interested before, you change your mind when the woman mentions "dream."

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: It seems you already know what you want to ask.
She takes your hand and places it onto the crystal ball. For a moment, the whistling sand seems to halt, and the world falls into silence. All you hear is the voice of the woman before you.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ahead of you, the raging gale brings destruction and the mighty earth trembles without end. The ends of the world shall be shaken, and so shall the abyss.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: And you... ignorance shall bring about your fall and fear shall bring about your collapse. You shall be taken away from your past to face the chaos of the unknown.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But there is no need to turn back. There is someone ahead to tread the path for you; someone to block the gale for you. As long as you march on, you have a chance to reach the true...
The face of the woman in front of you becomes a blur. Her smiling words dissipate mid-air.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Who? How can they help me to reach there?

steps.content: You cannot wait to ask more, but you don't get any answers. A loud siren blasts across the port, pulling you out of the thick, shrouded air.

A magnificent ship approaches from the air, the blue light atop its bridge flickering through the whirling sand. As it slowly lands before you, Hella lets out an excited cry and pushes you and Hecate toward it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That's a Hypercube force field that weakens the Apocalypse and protects the sand ship as it travels through the Tide of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Looks like the FAC's greeting party has arrived. This will be our ship.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew! Help has arrived! And in a super cool luxury cruise ship, too!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Come on, all aboard! Maiden voyage out of DisCity by Team Hella of the MBCC Special Combat Force, setting sail now!
Hella's excitement completely usurps her initial fear and demurral. In front of this steely giant, she is jumping up and down like a starry-eyed schoolgirl on a field trip.
You, however, still have your mind on the encounter just now.

Does the ship's arrival mean that the prophecy has been fulfilled? Or is it just a bluffing ploy? You turn to look at the narrow path behind you. The woman who divined for you has vanished, as if she never existed.
Only the interrupted prophecy lingers in your ears.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Go on... someone ahead will light up the stars for you and take you back to where you truly belong...
